name: @adhd/sox-extension-tui-design
description: Design and build clean, professional, minimal terminal UI (TUI) applications and command-line tools. Covers full-screen TUIs (file managers, dashboards, monitors, git/k8s tools, REPLs), interactive CLI prompts, and simple command-line utilities. Includes per-ecosystem deep-dives (Go/Bubble Tea, Rust/Ratatui, Python/Textual, TypeScript/Ink), visual and interaction pattern references, exemplar app analysis, and universal TUI design principles.
author: gfargo (harvested); sox-ecosystem
